verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Rules v2 supports draft/shadow-mode testing and backtesting (lithic-docs-4, lithic-docs-17/18), but there is no evidence of a version-history, review workflow, or rollback mechanism for automations/rules themselves. API versioning (lithic-docs-7, lithic-docs-19) pertains to the API contract, not to automation configuration history. Missing for 10: rule/automation change history, review/approval flow, and explicit rollback capability.
